trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Asymmetric spatial padding tuple (h, w) where h != w, e.g., (0, 1).
trigger_condition.value_trigger: padding_mode='circular' combined with an asymmetric padding tuple.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Forward execution of torch.nn.Conv2d with asymmetric padding and padding_mode='circular'.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Input is 4D (N, C, H, W); padding is a 2-tuple with different height and width padding amounts; padding_mode is 'circular'.

bug_oracle.description: Conv2d output has circular padding applied along the wrong spatial dimension when asymmetric padding is specified; e.g., padding=(0, 1) pads along H instead of W.
bug_oracle.signal: Output spatial shape or padded values differ from the expected dimension order.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary padding tuples and spatial input shapes to produce asymmetric height/width padding configurations.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct 4D input tensors with distinct and sufficiently large height and width dimensions so dimension-specific padding effects can be observed.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Set padding_mode='circular' and supply asymmetric padding tuples where height and width padding values differ.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Execute Conv2d forward with parameter combinations such as (0,1), (1,0), (1,2), and (2,1) across varying spatial sizes.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare Conv2d output against a reference implementation that applies circular padding explicitly along the correct spatial dimension before convolution.
